results.description:
*Best Phone Call App on the App Store*

Stay connected with anyone worldwide! Break communication barriers and use this streamlined and innovative app to make cheap calls to over 200 destinations globally. Enjoy the convenience of signing up for a virtual SIM and get a second phone number for destinations like the USA, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, Brazil, Belgium, Mexico, Israel and Austria. You can also use our high-quality phone call recorder to record and play calls whenever you want. Try the app now!


== GET A SECOND PHONE NUMBER
Want to call your overseas friends, family, and colleagues using a second phone number? Sign up on this app, create a user account, and subscribe to get a WeTalk Pro international phone number. Use USA/Canada/UK/Australia/Hong Kong phone numbers to make calls and send/receive SMS/MMS to anyone worldwide.

== ENJOY CHEAP CALLS INTERNATIONALLY
Use WiFi, 3G, 4G, or LTE internet connections to make calls with anyone globally. The app offers fast connections, crystal-clear audio quality, and 100% transparency and security. No need to pay a penny over your subscription package as this app won't charge hidden fees or extra costs. Use the pay-as-you-go subscription method and choose from three different calling packages:

Premium Line – for the best quality
Economy Line – for low calling rates
Callback Line – call without an internet connection!

== CALL PRICE IS AMAZINGLY LOW, TO LIST A FEW:
United States: $0.02/min
China: $0.08/min
India: $0.01/min
Vietnam: $0.06/min
Hong Kong/Taiwan: $0.05/min

== BEST-QUALITY PHONE CALL RECORDER
Enjoy a built-in call recorder to record important calls and save them within the same app for later playback. You can also view your calling history, billing history, phone number, and account information from the app home menu. Enjoy round-the-clock customer support. Use free credits to make trial calls to check the audio quality.

HOW TO USE WETALK PRO?
- Download and launch the phone calls app.
- Get a second phone number from USA/Canada/UK/Australia/Hong Kong or other regions.
- Send texts and call your friends using a virtual SIM number.
- Choose any of the cheap call lines.
- Use the phone call recorder to record and play calls.

FEATURES OF WETALK PRO
- Simple and easy virtual SIM app UI/UX.
- 30% cheaper than Skype.
- Clutter-free phone call recorder layout featuring smooth and responsive controls.
- Check call history, payment history, and chatting history from the app.
- Enjoy cheap calls to more than 200 different destinations.
- Get a second phone number to send and receive SMS/MMS.
- Safe and secure international calling app for everyone.
- Make cheap calls or answer calls from anywhere globally using a second phone number.
- Cheap calls to India, China, USA, Nigeria, Mexico, UK, Brazil, Thailand, UAE, Germany, - France, Kuwait, Australia, Indonesia, Philippines, Egypt, etc.
- Make calls over WiFi/4G/3G/GPRS, no roaming costs even when calling from abroad; call from anywhere at the same rates!
Note: making calls with 3G/4G/GPRS incurs data usage.
- Pay-as-you-go credit, top up your wallet using Apple ID.
- Choose call lines like Premium Line/Economy Line/Callback Line.
- Receive daily free credits.

Are you excited to make cheap phone calls using a second phone number from your virtual SIM? If yes, you have found the right international calling and texting app. Download and use WeTalk Pro to talk and record calls easily!

Please visit the company website for FAQs and other information: 
Learn more at https://www.wetalkapp.com 

Need Help? Support email: support@wetalkapp.com
